scope: Terraform-only local parity delivery; no publishing, backend/Pulumi changes or live infrastructure acceptance.

evidence.inventory: Current constructors reflected through a scratch Go overlay; embedded IAMIdentity/ManagedBrowserSettings expanded; production Go AST supplies source anchors. No credential values are exported.

evidence.rdp_validation: Schema, constructor, plan, create/update tests reject blank required target identities and out-of-range ports; preserve 3389 default, unknown expressions and literal nonblank values.

credential_policy: Refresh retains withheld observations; recognized-held-secret omission rejects full-blob updates; supplied values or supported explicit empty clears authorize writes. Sensitive values can persist in state/plans.
excluded_or_backend_blocked: Native write-only inputs and atomic server-side omitted-credential preservation deferred by user.
Backend contextual Google/1Password redaction and completeness/key-generation metadata remain outside Terraform scope.
Backend schedule timezone updates and existing duration removal are rejected locally.
Backend script/authorization description clears are rejected locally.
Atomic persistence/publication and post-write fingerprint acknowledgment require backend changes.
Live IAM/TLS/SSH/RDP/browser/session/masking enforcement and Kubernetes cleanup were not tested.
Push, release and deployment were not authorized.
coverage_limit: Key/type inventory and representative real-engine convergence are not exhaustive conditional-state or live connection proof. Explicitly rejected backend operations are not implemented capabilities.
